name: Major Project Part 1
description: This is a project based work. The student is expected to meet the supervisor regularly at least once a week and discuss the progress in his/her project. The scope of work would vary from project to project and would be decided by the supervisor. The student is expected to spend about 168 hours of laboratory work in addition to other background / development work related to the project.
